name: northlit
description: An AI Creative Director for your team: explore many directions at once, every one on brand through the Brand Graph, then build, edit and ship images, video and prototypes — from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: An AI Creative Director that keeps every idea on brand
interface.longDescription: Northlit gives every creative an AI Creative Director. Hand it a brief and it explores a board of genuinely divergent directions — every one on brand, because the Brand Graph underneath carries your palette, type, voice, exact logo and guidelines through master brands, sub-brands and product lines. Pick a direction and it keeps going: variations, a working HTML prototype you refine in plain language, a creative-director critique with the fix ready to apply, publish to a public URL. It runs on the best image and video models (GPT Image 2.5, Gemini, FLUX.2, Seedance, Kling, Veo) inside a full suite: Studio layer editing, 4K upscales, a video timeline with captions, voiceover and music, brand books and design systems from the same DNA. Everything lands on your own Northlit canvases. Boards and images render inline; click any card to view it full size.
defaultPrompt: Explore design directions for this brief.
Create a working prototype from this direction.
